run_train_network: run train_network to train models with cluster assignments as targets using a DataLoader and DistUnifTargSampler
run_validate_network: run validate_network to evaluate models on a validation loader and return accuracy and loss metrics
create_DistUnifTargSampler: create a DistUnifTargSampler that distributively samples elements based on a uniform distribution over pseudo labels
run_save_checkpoint: run save_checkpoint to save model state dicts and optimizer states to a checkpoint file on disk
run_accuracy: run accuracy to compute top-k prediction accuracy for sub-class and optional super-class outputs
